scope: src/raster/tile.c and src/raster/tile.h storage contract only

entries.adaptation: Invalid dimensions and checked-size failure are returned as TileError; the 4096 axis cap makes arithmetic overflow unreachable on the supported Apple Silicon target, but checked operations remain.

entries.rust_symbol: Tile::new; Tile::width; Tile::height; Tile::byte_count; Tile::rgba; Tile::rgba_mut
entries.adaptation: C's bool plus nullable out pointer is a Result<Tile, TileError>; dimensions and byte count are read-only methods; bytes are borrowed through immutable or mutable slices. C storage is malloc-owned and initialized to the same deterministic opaque row-major RGBA values.

Explicit destroy, null input, and zeroing the caller's C struct are replaced by unique Rust ownership and automatic release on drop; no dangling/double-free state can be represented through the safe API.

out_of_memory: Vec::try_reserve_exact maps allocation failure to TileError::OutOfMemory. A deterministic allocator-failure assertion is not available in this std-only crate; no OOM test is claimed.
